# secureaccess_network (Resource)

This resource manages a Network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_network" "example" {
  name          = "my_network"
  status        = "OPEN"
  is_dynamic    = true
  prefix        = "192.168.1.0"
  prefix_length = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `is_dynamic` (Boolean) Specifies whether the IP is dynamic.
- `name` (String) Name of the Network.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Subnet prefix length.
  - Range: `29`-`32`
- `status` (String) Status of the Network.
  - Choices: `OPEN`, `CLOSED`

### Optional

- `prefix` (String) Subnet prefix.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_network.example "<id>"
```
